packages.label: אֱמוּנָה שְׁלֵמָה וּמַאֲרִיךְ רוּחוֹ
packages.label_en: Complete Faith and Length of Spirit
packages.reason: אמונה שלמה and מאריך רוחו share the same essential nature: they are two expressions of the same positive spiritual reality. The Rebbe states explicitly — 'שאין להם אמונה שלמה, שהיא בחינת מאריך רוחו' — perfect faith IS a bechina of 'length of spirit.' The two concepts are not cause and effect (faith does not produce length of spirit; rather, full faith and long-spirit are the same interior quality described from two angles). This is the positive pole of the ruach-emunah spectrum that structures the entire Torah. The Rebbe cites Likutay Moharan I, 155 as a cross-reference for this identification. This package is the good mirror of Package 3 (the evil pole of heresy/no-ruach) and the contrast class for Package 2 (deficient faith/short-spirit).

packages.label: קְטַנֵּי אֲמָנָה וְקֹצֶר רוּחַ
packages.label_en: Little Faith and Shortness of Spirit
packages.reason: קטני אמנה and קצר רוח are two expressions of the same deficient spiritual state: lacking complete faith IS shortness of spirit. The Rebbe states — 'הקטני אמנה הם בחינת מקצר רוח' — and explains this is an intermediate position, neither the fullness of good (אמונה שלמה = מאריך רוחו) nor the total absence of spirit characteristic of heresy. The bechina identification is explicit: קצר רוח is the precise inner phenomenology of what it means to be a קטן אמנה. This is not an eitza relationship (failing faith does not cause short spirit; they are the same interior condition named twice). The Rebbe also notes that even righteous people can be in this state, and it is this deficiency that necessitates harsh avodah and fasting. The polarity is 'evil' in the sense of a spiritual flaw requiring correction — it is the domain of קלקול אמונה (impairment of faith), the middle zone on the spectrum between Package 1 (complete faith) and Package 3 (total heresy).

packages.label: עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה וְכְּפִירָה — אֵין רוּחַ
packages.label_en: Idol Worship and Heresy — No Spirit
packages.reason: עבודה זרה והכפירות and 'אף אין יש רוח בהם' share the same essential nature: idolatry and heresy ARE the state of having absolutely no ruach whatsoever. The Rebbe cites Psalms 135 explicitly — 'העבודה זרה והכפירות הם בחינת: אף אין יש רוח בהם' — to establish that this describes the intrinsic nature of idols and the heretics who follow them: they are spirit-empty. This is not a consequence of heresy; it IS what heresy is at its core — the total absence of the ruach/emunah dimension. The node '"אף אין יש רוח בהם"' is a biblical phrase functioning as a concept-label: the defining characteristic of the evil pole on the ruach spectrum. This package is the evil mirror of Package 1 (אמונה שלמה = מאריך רוחו): the same ruach axis, but at its complete absence rather than its fullness.

structural_note: This Torah constructs a single linear spectrum of ruach/emunah with three zones: (1) good — complete faith = long spirit; (2) intermediate/failing — little faith = short spirit; (3) evil — heresy/idolatry = no spirit. All three components map onto this single axis. The three packages are kept separate because each represents a qualitatively distinct zone on the spectrum, not variations of the same essential nature. The good/evil mirror is: Package 1 (אמונה שלמה) mirrors Package 3 (עבודה זרה) as the two poles of the ruach axis. Package 2 (קטני אמנה) is the intermediate failing zone — the Torah's primary subject — that sits between the poles and requires harsh avodah as its corrective.
